digest.component_or_area: Type checking configuration and Mypy ratchet
propositions: Enable Mypy strict flags (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) globally in configuration while explicitly deferring disallow_any_generics and disallow_untyped_defs.

Remove unused type: ignore comments identified by warn_unused_ignores across 22 files in the rebar_reconciler and related modules, ensuring all suppressions are verified as genuinely unused in the canonical fully-provisioned CI environment.
Fix redundant cast diagnostics including the int cast at editor.py:515 while retaining the adjacent str cast unless independently diagnosed as redundant.
Add a ratchet test in test_mypy_ratchet.py that enforces the four approved strict flags are enabled and the two deferred flags remain disabled.
